assertions.assertion: Recommends setting options.KeyManagement.Enabled = false in test configuration
assertions.rationale: Shows options.KeyManagement.Enabled = false in the AddIdentityServer options.

assertions.assertion: Recommends AddDeveloperSigningCredential(persistKey: false) to avoid disk writes
assertions.rationale: Shows .AddDeveloperSigningCredential(persistKey: false) as in-memory, nothing written.

assertions.assertion: Warns against hard-coding localhost ports — use factory.CreateClient() BaseAddress instead
assertions.rationale: Section 2 contrasts hard-coded localhost:5001 with new Uri(client.BaseAddress!, "connect/token") from factory.CreateClient().

assertions.assertion: Mentions the risk of sharing HttpClient or ClaimsProvider state across parallel tests
assertions.rationale: Section 4 explicitly warns a shared HttpClient/ClaimsProvider lets identity bleed between tests under parallelism.
